text:
Alex: quick question — need to hand off a loghunt to oncall for the acme route in eu-gen. can someone drop the minimal search snippet + a dashboard/snapshot link? we also want to lower the alert sensitivity for a spike of 5xx transient errors (not the full outage).

Maria: ok — for acme route requests in EU-gen, use this as a starting query in Logsearch:```service:ingest route:acme region:eu model:gen status:5..``` then add `| count()` and group by 1m for p95.

Maria: dashboard link (live view): https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/route-health/acme-eu?org=acme&var-region=eu

Jia: +1 to Maria's query. if you want to catch KV/cache misses add `kvcache_miss:true` filter. example:```service:ingest route:acme region:eu model:gen kvcache_miss:true status:5.. | stats count() by 1m``` this narrows noisy 5xx from cold-cache rebuilds.

Sam: for the alert tune, suggest keeping the current p95 threshold but bump eval window to 10m and require 3/4 consecutive evals before firing. that should reduce noisy pager storms.

Sam: alert config snippet (Grafana alert rule):```if (p95(request_duration) > 800ms) for 10m and count(status=5xx) > 5 then alert```

Maria: also created a short-lived bookmarked view in Logsearch so oncall can re-run quickly — snapshot id: snap_2026_03_acme_eu. infra-bot should have posted it.

infra-bot: saved view created by Maria — ID snap_2026_03_acme_eu — link: https://logsearch.redwood.internal/snapshot/snap_2026_03_acme_eu (expires in 7 days)

Alex: perfect — can you also paste a tiny example of the combined query used in the dashboard panel? want to include it in the runbook.

Maria: dashboard panel uses this aggregated query:```source:logs | filter service=="ingest" and route=="acme" and region=="eu" and status >=500 and status <600 | parse time_bucket(1m) | aggregate(count) | compute(p95, latency)``` paste that in the runbook.

Jia: for followups: if we still see high 5xx but kvcache_miss is low, escalate to runtime team (mark @runtime). otherwise leave alert set as Sam suggested.

Alex: thanks all — i'll update the runbook with the query, dashboard snapshot link, and the adjusted alert eval. cc @oncall for visibility. :thumbsup:

Sam: noted — i'll monitor next couple rolls and adjust if we get false negatives.

Alex: closing the handoff. if anyone wants the saved view made permanent, ping Maria and she'll move it to the org-level presets.
